get.description: Pages over native items newest-first. A response carrying `nextCursor` may still have more behind it -- pass that value back as `cursor` to continue. `state`/`principal`/`repo` filter each page after it is read, so an empty `items` array with a `nextCursor` present means "none on this page", not "no more pages" -- keep paging until `nextCursor` is absent to see every matching item (issue #1546).
